data.name: The Perishing World
data.detailed_description:
A deadly blood plague has turned the world into chaos. Cities have fallen, the military has collapsed, and the infected roam every road and ruin.

You play as a prisoner who escapes during the outbreak after the country is overrun by the infected. Alone, your only goal is to survive the horrors of the plague and find a way back home.

Scavenge for supplies, explore abandoned locations, avoid deadly infected, and fight through a collapsing world where every encounter can mean life or death. From quarantined towns and ruined highways to dark forests and abandoned facilities, survival depends on your choices and your ability to adapt.

With a tense atmosphere, immersive exploration, and brutal survival-focused gameplay, the journey home becomes a desperate fight to stay alive in a world consumed by the Blood Plague.

data.short_description: Survive a collapsing world consumed by the Blood Plague in this emotional third-person horror shooter. Fight infected creatures, scavenge for supplies, and journey through semi-open environments as a prisoner trying to survive long enough to return home.

English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic*, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian
*languages with full audio support

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains realistic violence, blood, zombie-like infected creatures, armed combat, character deaths, and a dark oppressive horror atmosphere. Some environments and survival-related themes set in a collapsing world may be disturbing to some players. No explicit sexual content is present.
